title: Las Vegas ATV Tour with Free Transportation
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Embark on an unforgettable 2-hour off-road adventure through the Las Vegas desert in a brand-new 4-seat Polaris or Yamaha Side-by-Side, guided by experts. EagleRider offers a unique experience with full-face helmets, fresh air supply, and in-vehicle communication systems for clear instructions and fun chatter. This fully guided tour starts with hotel pick-up and takes you to the 40,000 sq/ft Adventure Center before heading to the Mojave Desert to explore rocky trails, Joshua Tree fields, and stunning slot canyons. Perfect for both beginners and seasoned riders, this adventure lets you explore at your own pace while making memories in the heart of the desert.
